provenance_warning: prereg.md section 7.1 does NOT contain a frozen origin list. It enumerates 12 illustrative eTLD+1 entries (one self-declared duplicate), asserts '25 credential-free public origins' and simultaneously asserts '12 unique', then states 'The exact 25 origins will be recorded in frozen_origins.json at freeze time with SHA256. ... The real list is generated by a deterministic seed from the request.json request_hash and recorded in the freeze artifact.' freeze.json contains ONLY the three digests of prereg.md, request.json and spec.json; it references no origin list, no frozen_origins.json and no mechanism pool. This file is therefore EXECUTOR-CONSTRUCTED and POST-FREEZE, not frozen. It is the single largest frozen-design defect in this packet and is recorded as validity_notes V-A. The origin pool is NOT pre-registered in any verifiable sense.
construction_rule_applied: Candidate universe = the 12 unique eTLD+1 entries literally enumerated in prereg.md section 7.1 (httpbin.org is listed twice; the prereg itself removes the duplicate and says '12 unique'). The prereg's declared 'deterministic seed from request_hash' rule is NOT APPLICABLE because the prereg supplies no superset universe to seed from and no seed-to-origin mapping; seeding from a 12-element universe cannot produce the 25 origins the prereg simultaneously asserts. Recorded as a prereg internal contradiction, not silently repaired.

Mandate disjointness clause applied BEFORE selection (AGENTS.md precedence: request.json director_mandate outranks spec.json and prereg.md). The binding director_mandate.allocation.question requires the pool be 'disjoint from the graph and frontier host sets this cycle'. Frontier host sets recorded in codex/experiments/EXP-FRONTIER-36306528608 and EXP-FRONTIER-36293269574 and in codex/claim_state.json (latest C-MEAS-VALID event) are {httpbin.org, catfact.ninja, dog.ceo, ipify.org (api.ipify.org), api.chucknorris.io, zenquotes.io}. The Graph host set is EMPTY for the prereg candidate universe (EXP-GRAPH-36302977302 and EXP-GRAPH-36287167610 contain none of these hosts), so the graph clause is vacuously satisfied.

Consequence: 5 of the 12 prereg candidates are excluded by the mandate, and 4 of those 5 (httpbin.org, catfact.ninja, dog.ceo, ipify.org) plus api.chucknorris.io are the only candidates in the prereg list that expose identifier-bearing GET-path templates with genuine 404/200 variation. See raw/excluded_host_template_inventory.jsonl for the measured cost of this exclusion.
seed_material_note: No sampling seed is used to select origins. Deterministic seeds derived from request_hash are used for identifier-value sampling, the 70/30 identifier split, the placebo pool permutation, the permutation nulls and the site-clustered bootstrap, and are recorded in provenance.json.
